reviews.text:
For the most authentic ‘Shivaji’ restaurant experience in Bangalore, especially famous for its traditional Biryani and hotel fare, one establishment stands above all others.
Shivaji hotel
Go here strictly for the food. Naati style Biryani is excellent. Didn't try other dishes. Stuck to what this place is known for. Ambience is non existent. Hygiene is very basic.
Very nice place kind person I ever see good taste great quality
Nice one in the surrounding comparatively to other

One of the worst, useless hotel in terms of food and service I experienced here , plzz don't waste your money and ur time , when we ordered egg biriyani these useless people serving cold rice and telling us today is Sunday plz adjust , and y the hell I adjust after paying so much money , and  for paying bill nobody is there to tell total amt we have to call them 5 times to come and tell overall bill and there is no thankyou coming from their mouth.
Worst behaviour. They don't even have onions or raita. If you ask, they give the reason that the price of vegetables is high. What the hell are they running the hotel for? Better close it.

Overcrowded place. Food is good, but service is not that great. You have to stand near table and wait for the person to finish food. When your turn comes, other people will be staring at you to finish fast. Limited options were available for lunch. Crowd could have been managed better.
Worst mutton biryani and no kannada

This is just a place we found on the way to the airport,

Cheap food but very interesting, must visit to these places at least once, the uniqueness of the food something very different, kinda enjoyed it, it was light to the stomach, doesn’t look like a very pleasant place but it’s like road side food quick and I do not know but really interesting and it’s a must try on your way to the airport

The taste of the food is good.  We ordered parotta, egg gravy , mushroom gravy , and egg biriyani. Parotta was little charred but not bad.  Egg Gravy and mushroom gravy are great. Biriyani is nice but you'll like only if you like mint leaves ( pudhina)

Completely waste...

Biryani and all food was extra spicy.. You can't eat that... Change the chef, otherwise tell him to learn.

Worst place ever.. restaurant is pathetic and food is worst here.. kindly don go here you will regret later.. they don know how to talk and serve.. worst restaurant till now in my lifetime.. they don deserve one star also pathetic..
Ordered mutton biriyani from here tastes good with gravy even better and frehs and hot.. ... Only thing the mutton was little hard... Will soon  try their other dish...
Tasty food..but no cleaning the table.....then plate we want to remove...self plate remove ,👎 at morning breakfast time

owner_response.text: Thanks for noticing this.. We usually clean tables immediately.. We Will make sure this will not repeat..

reviews.text: Good food at very reasonable prices
